description: Make a glow map from an edit that switched lights on (or made a night version with lights glowing): the light the edit added over the picture it came from, on transparency, for an additive or emissive layer in a game. Same size as the picture. Pass the edit's frameId (from get_asset). Free.

frameId.description: The edit (a frame from get_asset) whose light to keep

id.description: Asset ID (from list_assets / get_asset or a previous result)

name: make_glow_map
